title: What the Boards Kept

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The voice goes over the boards and the slate goes up the road; neither stands in the yard to be asked, and the well will tell you only the weather.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the women at the yard well in Low Kiln, told on a morning of Frost

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and ninety-one to two hundred and ninety-three days, six months and one hundred and eleven to one hundred and thirteen days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing — the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the six hearings of the full note kept beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell kept beside the told; the told figure kept beside the paid; Frost's first and second arithmetics locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road with the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid; the Frost 14 well-saying held with one saying and one second shaping, and in this chapter a third, each on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining and not paid; the nine stoppings with no tenth, the nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread, the five askings with one shaping and no witness; the held interval and the empty interval kept as objects on the sixth place; the small coordinations of the hand entered on that place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule — with no present-tense Chicago break and no tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no sixth hearing, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no sixth asking for the row question and no witness, no tenth record-first hand, no eighth of the green or ninth of the shape, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause, no private record opened, read or copied, and no ending. Frost 22, 23 and 24 are ordinary tending days with no market, Cross or bell; the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and not paid, is a third shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying — an ownerless voice over the boards saying that the slate-runner once carried a name the district spent and did not say whose — filed beside the first two with a finger between every pair; three shapings must not stand up as a witness, a cause, a confession or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands, and no shaping makes Hessa a reader.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Twenty-Second Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{291}{Frost 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell. Open with the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and fifty-sixth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking; a round threshold of answers did not stand up and call itself a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. No recap — the reader has just read ch 79. Carry 290 to 291 exact, six months and one hundred and eleven days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-one days, its payer unnamed (T088). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, entered nowhere (T060/T086). Three counts in three places — the carried fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — and agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands (T088, T061/T082). Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell beside the told bell of the Long Night in its square; the Frost 14 saying held with one saying and one second shaping beside Hessa Rale's eighth record-first hand with a finger between; nine stoppings with no tenth; five askings with one shaping and no witness; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread in her sleeve (T080/T101/T036 held). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, turns the coals with a broken pot, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf's front edge, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and gives it no figure, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, and gives every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket (T058/T079, T100, T077). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note and takes the small intake of the fire's silence carried through the floor across the interval to the first morning's own going, filing the one hundred and fifty-seventh answer as an object exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the surgeon's clean satisfaction is checked by the infant's louder want of the crust, and the checking is the work, not a virtue (T061/T082). Frost 30 (Day 299), the month's third and last Account-day, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it; he makes nothing of the nearness and does not let it stand up as a sign.

scenes.title: The Seven Places
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 291, no new dated heading: afternoon at the Clay Yard, the yard well and skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, into the small hours at the bed and the towel. Afternoon thins without ending the way heat goes out of a pot set off the coals and left on a cold stone; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack where the broken birth-slates lie; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print or word; the trough skinned over and its water called weather; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out. Seven are seven and not an account; the missing hand carried, not named, not paid and not joined to the fold's one crust, the dressed grain or the man carried out on Day 188 (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The stayed frost lies white on the well lip and the plate of ice stands clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet; weather entered nowhere, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named to either (T083/T085 held). Garl stays in objects and not in a story: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg, the wheel-seat keeping its twenty-year lean and its hollow nobody fills, the clean dark line with its finer grey beside it, the proverb gone to the pot and the fire, and the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled; his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-one days, and no collector came up or went down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the very lip where it cannot, with Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it (no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford, no figure on the debt); he tells the wood Six counted. The next I don't count in the tone of a man stating the weather, says Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying though the paying stands in the ruts, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, draws the Seed 16 breath and does not spend it, keeps Ash in the knuckle creases the colour of the clean dark line, holds the pale clip-ring to what light there is, and sweeps over the shallow bright patch without the half-check while the warm stone in its unmarked loft pot stays cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width-open shed edge with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal into both forearms past the bent little finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip; he keeps dusty forearms and clean ones on one tray, speaks to the wheel before any person (It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady) and tells a pot You'll do with no welcome and no unkindness, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it, gives the unnamed men in the back room no name and does not say the room is cold, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot; burned slate at four from Slate Row, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, moves her lips along a row standing with two gaps and gives neither gap a figure; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs, because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). In the small hours the hand takes two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch his, sets them side by side with a finger between, leaves the letting-go between them where it was and makes neither agree with the fire's missing fifth: the one hundred and fifty-eighth answer, an object worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Twenty-Third Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{292}{Frost 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; Frost 23 comes on its own morning and nothing of the two days before is brought into it. Carry 291 to 292 exact, six months and one hundred and twelve days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-two days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before: hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool, the sour breath of the unswept corner called the thaw, the river low over lower under the finger's-width door, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell (T088, T061/T082). Body inventory in the old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed empty place and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; the composed face that is not composure, the cold patient who will seem better before he is worse, the knowledge that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T060/T086). Three counts in three places with no agreement among them, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell beside the told in its square; the Frost 14 saying with one saying and one second shaping on a place of its own beside Hessa's eighth hand with a finger between, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining and not paid (T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held). Sella's grammar holds exactly: fire before basket, instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never the basket, The house will keep it, half-pace from every open slate, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, widow's mark untouched at a morning because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100, T060/T086). The dressed grain is turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and given no figure; Frost's first and second arithmetics stay locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road with the printed one in twelve unchallenged, and the numbers that read over the covered grain do not know what it cost, the space between figure and price still unsigned (T077, T015/T041/T047 carried). The hand comes up an inch and takes the small intake of the fire's silence rising through the floor down onto the river's next low note of water over water, keeping the two sounds in two places and not making them agree; the one hundred and fifty-ninth answer is filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, and the surgeon's clean satisfaction is checked by the infant's louder want, the checking being the work and not a virtue (T061/T082). Frost 30 (Day 299), the third and last Account-day, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it.

scenes.title: The Third Shaping
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Frost 23 through the going of the light into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and skinned trough, the boards and the well-roof, the kindling and the wheel-shed edge, the bed and the towel. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T080):** an unnamed voice over the boards and the well-roof, with no owner standing anywhere to be asked, no room, no hand at a slate, no name for the person, no figure spoken, no confession and no cause, gives the Frost 14 saying a third shaping: the slate-runner once carried a name the district spent and did not say whose. The voice goes on with the day the way the yard says the weather and nobody turns twice. The boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and files it on a place of its own beside the first saying and the second shaping with a finger between every pair, a third shaping toward the far-off day she must choose whether to read what she has carried for years — not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a tenth hand, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a witness and not paid; it does not make Hessa Rale a reader and is not joined to Ilva's strip in a sleeve a pace away (Ilva offstage), to Berr's twice-wiped thumb, to the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate or to the charcoal under the shelf. Three shapings must not stand up as a witness, a cause, a confession or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands to any of them. The ownerless row question is explicitly kept at five askings with one shaping and no witness — the shaping of the well-saying is not a sixth asking and is not the row's shaping; the burned slate stays at four with no fifth telling, the shut-room tellings at two with no third, the pot sayings at three with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, the green a colour and the foundling's shape a shape with no eighth, the hands nine with Ilva's ninth unread and no tenth, the stoppings nine with no tenth before the seventh year's very end (T101, T035/T031/T065/T095, T064, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076 held). Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on its flat stone stay weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085 held). Tarn keeps six checkable and a seventh at the lip and stops the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth; Jorra parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot, withholds the note and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-two days and no collector on the clay road. In the small hours the hand takes two intakes held apart with a finger between where the three shapings stand with a finger between every pair, leaves the letting-go between the intakes where it was, borrows no house count and supplies no fifth to the kiln: the one hundred and sixtieth answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Nothing of the saying is brought under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment.

scenes.title: The Twenty-Fourth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{293}{Frost 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. New day, new date, no recap; Frost 24 comes on its own morning and the third shaping of yesterday is not brought into it as a witness, cause, confession or payment. Carry 292 to 293 exact, six months and one hundred and thirteen days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-three days, its payer unnamed (T088). First smells and sounds as before, and the body inventoried in the old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; he knows a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse, and that a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder, and the older keeps the inventory while the younger keeps the wanting, neither with authority over the other (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty; the heard bell beside the told; the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying held on their own place with a finger between every pair, not a rule, and the boy's own gaps held on another with a finger between the two keepings (T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held, T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, says The house will keep it, turns the coals with a broken pot, keeps the charcoal unread, sets the pot rim two inches out with its handle toward the reaching hand and a half-beat before she goes away without a look toward the bed, turns the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and gives it no figure, and leaves the widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100, T077). The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's own going and takes the letting-go of an intake on the same note, kept whole and set beside the held interval with a finger between — not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift — filing the one hundred and sixty-first answer as an object exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the surgeon's clean satisfaction at the exact coordination is checked by the infant's plain want of the crust two inches off, and the checking is the work and he does not call it a virtue (T061/T082). Frost 30 (Day 299), the month's third and last Account-day and market, stands six mornings ahead and is not made a sign of or brought into this day.

scenes.title: Six Mornings Off
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 293, Frost 24, afternoon into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the back room as a direction and a sound, the bed, the boards and the towel. Frost goes on without a boundary drawn and neither of the district's two habits of naming its months is set right or left wrong; no lesson is made of either arithmetic behind and no payer named; the next opening stands in the first firing of a later month, far off, not hoped for and not counted toward; four openings in four months are four and not a rule (T058/T079). Afternoon thins without ending; heat draws back from the fold; the inventory is renewed in the old order, exact and unentered (T061/T082, T060/T086). The yard goes around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the stayed frost on the well lip, the skinned trough and the plate of ice clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet stay weather entered nowhere, no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). Tarn at the kindling keeps six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, stops the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, keeps the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal, parts dusty forearms from clean, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead, gives the unnamed back-room men no name and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he's not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Garl stays in objects and not in a story — salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey thaw unswept, proverb gone to the pot and the fire, tile debt worse for being uncalled — his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-three days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella carries him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, puts the fold right without a look at his face, leaves the thread frozen, tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says The house will keep it where another woman would say I, keeps her finger above the charcoal so it stays unread, moves her lips along the two-gapped row with neither gap figured, glances once at the clay jar cold under its lead glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gives no instruction at any hour to the basket; the widow's mark hangs where it hangs because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100, T060/T086). In the small hours the file is turned out on the towel as instruments on a tray, every thing in its own place with room between: six hearings with the seventh place kept empty, the small flat knock out of a woman filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell beside the told, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread in her sleeve and no tenth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the Frost 14 saying with its first, second and third shapings on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale's eighth hand with a finger between every pair, not a witness, not a confession, not a joining and not paid, Frost's first and second arithmetics locked in Berr's box with the printed one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, the covered grain, the stayed frost and the plate of ice. The finding that a house keeps by its not-doings stays on its own place and the boy's own gaps on another with a finger between — two gaps above the shelf, one crust in the fold and its unnamed empty place, the gone pan's round ring, the field's empty place and the returning-line place — no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, keeping maintenance and not a story (T060/T086, T097 held, T098 carried). Outside the wool the hand takes the held interval and the empty interval from the file, sets them side by side with a finger between, borrows no house count, supplies no fifth to the carried fire, crosses no silence belonging to another's breathing and comes down on the river's next low note of water over water; neither interval is promoted into a reach, a hearing, a gift, a keeping, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a doctrine or a rule. The one hundred and sixty-second answer is filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; a round threshold does not stand up as a doctrine, and three shapings do not stand up as a witness, for a witness stands somewhere and can be asked and none stands (T061/T082, T080). The hand lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Two hundred and ninety-three stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath; six months and one hundred and thirteen days are told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth is unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed. Nothing is opened, named, called, paid or ended. The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap, every tray parted by a finger's width and nothing that had moved. Frost the thirtieth (Day 299), the month's third and last Account-day and market, stands six mornings ahead and is not brought into this day; the boy makes nothing of the nearness and does not let it stand up as a sign. The crust stays two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third; beyond the finger's-width door the frost stands white on the well lip and the plate of ice stands clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet, and the river's low note of water over water goes quiet after the hand comes down.
